SHARETHELOAD.NonPlayerBearer: Not a player character: an NPC or vehicle sharing the load.
SHARETHELOAD.SourceHint.Group: A member of this loot actor's group. Group members are listed first, and ticked by default on a new pile.
SHARETHELOAD.SourceHint.Owned: Not in the group, but owned by a player. Giving the players ownership of an NPC is how a mule or hireling joins in.
SHARETHELOAD.SourceHint.Configured: Saved on this pile, but no longer in the group or owned by a player. Untick to remove their share; this row is the only place to do it.
SHARETHELOAD.Hint.Pile: Each loot actor keeps its own independent bearer list, so a character may carry shares from several piles at once.
SHARETHELOAD.Hint.Bearers: Listed are this loot actor's group members first, then any actor a player owns. To let an NPC such as a mule or hireling share the load, give the players ownership of it. Checked bearers have this pile's weight counted against their carrying capacity; the items never leave the loot actor.
SHARETHELOAD.Hint.Manual: Give each bearer a number of shares: 2, 1, 1 means the first carries half and the others a quarter each. Only the proportions matter.
SHARETHELOAD.Hint.CurrencyRuleOff: The dnd5e "Apply Currency Weight" rule is off, so coin weight is ignored regardless of this setting.
SHARETHELOAD.ButtonHint.Save: Save these settings, update every bearer's share, and close.
SHARETHELOAD.ButtonHint.Apply: Save these settings and update every bearer's share, keeping this window open.
SHARETHELOAD.ButtonHint.Clear: Remove this pile's shares from every bearer and stop distributing it. Tick Distribute This Pile and apply to resume.
SHARETHELOAD.Notify.Unchanged: Nothing to update: every bearer's share is already current.
SHARETHELOAD.Chat.Title: {pile} distributed
SHARETHELOAD.Chat.Stopped: {pile} is no longer being distributed. Its bearers' carrying capacity is back to normal.
SHARETHELOAD.Chat.Nothing: Nobody is carrying anything from it right now.
SHARETHELOAD.NoPiles: No group actors found. Create a group actor to use as a party loot pile.
SHARETHELOAD.NoBearers: No eligible bearers. Add members to this group actor, or give a player ownership of an actor.
SHARETHELOAD.EffectDescription: Carrying a {weight} share of the load from {pile}.
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.AutoSync.Name: Recalculate Automatically
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.AutoSync.Hint: Update carried shares whenever a configured loot actor's contents change. Turn off to apply only manually.
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Menu.Name: Bearer Configuration
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Menu.Hint: Choose which characters share the weight of each party loot actor.
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Menu.Label: Configure Bearers
SHARETHELOAD.Warn.EncumbranceOff: This world has encumbrance tracking disabled, so distributed weight will have no effect in play. Enable it under the dnd5e system settings.
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Purge.Name: Remove All Effects
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Purge.Hint: Strip every shared-load effect from every actor. Do this before disabling or uninstalling the module, or bearers keep their reduced capacity with nothing left to explain it.
SHARETHELOAD.Setting.Purge.Label: Remove All Effects
SHARETHELOAD.Purge.Title: Remove All Shared Load Effects
SHARETHELOAD.Purge.Prompt: Remove every effect this module has applied, from every actor in the world? Pile configurations are kept, so you can re-apply afterwards.
